title: Dual-anion ionic liquid electrolytes: a strategy for achieving high stability and conductivity in lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5277-5286
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00119F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jemin Lee, Wonwoo Choi, Eunbin Jang, Hyunjin Kim, Jeeyoung Yoo
The dual-anion ionic liquid electrolyte (D-LCILE) significantly improves lithium-ion mobility and SEI stability, leading to >99.93% capacity retention over 200 cycles in lithium metal full cells.
